notes: Account summary: Lumen ServeWorks is a retail-facing personalization + support platform exploring Dedicated capacity to guarantee sub-150ms p95 for chat while running high-throughput reranking and embeddings pipelines. Primary drivers: predictable tail latency for user-facing chat widgets, cost per session for millions of monthly active users, and contractual data residency + audit requirements. Prospect wants conservative utilization assumptions for committed GPUs before sign. Internal stakeholders: Head of ML (Eva Torres), Infra Lead (Marcus Li), Procurement (Elena Ward). AE/SE have been pushing three commit scenarios and a utilization sensitivity table.
technical_requirements: Workloads: mixed (chat low-latency, rerank high-throughput batch, nightly embeddings refresh). Targets: chat p95 < 150ms, median < 60ms; rerank throughput 4k-6k qps batched with target 10ms per batch, nightly embeddings 25M vectors/day. Latency SLOs require colocated KV cache + prefix caching. Must support SSO/SAML, audit logs, and KMS key wrap. Prefer baseline model family: open Llama-2-derivative quantized; fallback to smaller quantized variant when burst capacity needed.
poc_results_summary: POC (2026-03-04 to 2026-03-10) ran representative mixed traffic. Measured on Redwood Dedicated sandbox with GPU profile ~A100x4 equivalent: sustained 520 req/s for chat workload (avg prompt 8 tokens, generation avg 48 tokens), p50=42ms, p95=145ms. Reranking microbench: batched 64 candidates, achieved 9k batch-eval qps with avg 12ms per batch. Embeddings throughput peaked at 450k vectors/hour with batching and prefix caching. Observed 65-72% GPU occupancy during mixed runs. IO and KV cache misses drove p95 spikes.
cost_model_notes: High-level cost model (for discussion): baseline pricing assumptions used in POC: dedicated GPU run-rate $12,000/month per A100-equivalent (list estimate), plus platform fee $5k/mo. Option A (low commit): 2x A100 equiv reserved -> expected capacity: ~1.0k req/s chat baseline, projected utilization 45% for steady-state, blended per-token cost estimated at $0.00032/token at 60% utilization with batching and cache. Option B (recommended): 4x reserved -> measured POC performance matches SLO with p95~145ms; projected utilization 70% at current traffic; blended unit economics ~$0.00021/token. Option C (scale safety): 8x reserved -> headroom for growth and bursts, utilization target 50-60%, blended ~$0.00018/token after autoscaling/burst discounts. Key assumptions: avg generated tokens per chat session = 48, requests per session = 1.2, embeddings vector dim & cost mapped to compute minutes. Billing model shown excludes egress/residency premium and enterprise SLA fee. Sensitivity table prepared: each 10% drop in realized utilization increases unit cost ~7-9%. Recommend negotiating graduated commit pricing (volume breakpoints at 4x and 8x) and an elasticity clause for 12-month ramp to accommodate their Q3 growth spike.
sla_and_contract_notes: Procurement items: 99.9% uptime SLA on Dedicated control plane, per-request latency SLOs (p95 targets) with credit mechanics, committed capacity with defined scaling windows, runbook for failover to hosted cheaper model variant (graceful throttling). Legal asks: data residency binding addendum, proofs of SOC2 + penetration test summary, KMS integration spec. Proposed negotiation points: phased commit (4 months at 4x, validate, then step to 8x), convert unused committed GPU hours to billable credits or rollover for 6 months.
commercial_options_presented: 1) 2x A100-eq reserved: lower entry ARR, high unit cost, capacity risk. 2) 4x A100-eq reserved: recommended, balances SLO and economics. 3) 8x A100-eq reserved: enterprise headroom + lower unit cost. Optional add-ons: extended observability retention, real-time trace ingest for p95 debugging, private on-prem bundle for EU data residency.
negotiation_playbook: Prioritize: (a) guarantee p95 latency SLOs for chat with defined fallbacks; (b) flexible commit ramp with rollback on material underutilization; (c) capped annual price escalator; (d) residency + audit deliverables. Concessions we can offer: modest introductory discount on first 6 months for 12-month commit; convert up to 15% of committed GPU hours to credits if customer underutilizes below 60% for >60 days.
